caption:
soap or hand sanitizer: which is harder on your hands?

A 2022 review pooled 45 studies. Washing your hands 8 to 10 times a day or more was linked to about 1.5 times the risk of hand eczema, and 15 to 20 times to 1.66 times.

Alcohol hand sanitizer showed no clear link. If it stings, the skin may already be cracked.

These were observational studies, so they show a link, not the cause.

Save this for the next time your hands sting.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Source:
Loh & Yew, Contact Dermatitis 2022. doi:10.1111/cod.14133
